class DispatchError(ValueError)
  __init__(code)
enum LookupOutcome
  RESOLVED = 'resolved'
  INVALID = 'invalid'
  UNAVAILABLE = 'unavailable'
  UNSUPPORTED_MAPPING = 'unsupported_mapping'
  FORBIDDEN = 'forbidden'
dataclass LookupResult
  outcome: LookupOutcome | None
  request: _dependency_request.Request | None
enum ManifestOutcome
  RESOLVED = 'resolved'
  NOT_FOUND = 'not_found'
  INVALID = 'invalid'
  UNAVAILABLE = 'unavailable'
  UNSUPPORTED_MAPPING = 'unsupported_mapping'
  FORBIDDEN = 'forbidden'
dataclass ManifestResult
  outcome: ManifestOutcome | None
  manifest: _dependency_content.Manifest | None
  resolved_revision: str
class ModelManifest
  resolve(ref: Ref) -> ManifestResult
class ModelManifestClient(ModelManifest)
  __init__(transport)
  resolve(ref: Ref) -> ManifestResult
class ModelResolver
  resolve(ref: Ref) -> LookupResult
class ModelResolverClient(ModelResolver)
  __init__(transport)
  resolve(ref: Ref) -> LookupResult
const REGISTRY_OPERATIONS
const RESOLVER_OPERATIONS
dataclass Ref
  registry: str
  repo: str
  revision: str
  quant: str
  file: str
  credential: str
class Refusal(ValueError)
  __init__(word, offset)
class ServiceError(Exception)
  __init__(code, message)

  INVALID_RESULT = 'invalid_result'
  UNKNOWN_VERSION = 'unknown_version'
  UNKNOWN_SERVICE = 'unknown_service'
  UNKNOWN_METHOD = 'unknown_method'
  WRONG_MODE = 'wrong_mode'

def decode_lookup_result(data)
def decode_manifest_result(data)
